title: Run commutes with silent embedding
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let the distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ lie outside its image. For any $m$-tape machine $M$, initial configuration $c$, background tape contents and head positions, prefix and initial output, and natural number $t$, running the silent embedding for $t$ steps from the embedded configuration gives exactly the embedding of the configuration reached by running $M$ from $c$ for $t$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $\iota$ from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
The distinguished index $\mathrm{cap}$ is outside the image of $\iota$
